about: Quinte West is an amalgamated city on the Bay of Quinte in eastern Ontario, combining Trenton, Frankford, Sidney, and Murray rather than a single historic core. Trenton is the main urban centre and the home of 8 Wing, a major Royal Canadian Air Force base. The Trent River meets the bay here, with Highway 401 inland. About 47,000 people live in Quinte West.
seoSummary: Amalgamated Bay of Quinte city around Trenton, home to 8 Wing and the national air-force museum.
